query: Hi Support Team, we just pushed a new deployment for the payment-api service in staging, but it looks stuck. The new replica set isn't spinning up any pods at all. Checking the events, we see repeated FailedCreate errors mentioning an exceeded quota. Can someone take a look?

INCIDENT: prod-api rollout stalled. Pods are stuck in Running status without becoming Ready. Service endpoints have dropped significantly. Need urgent investigation into why the new revision is not accepting traffic.

Hello Support Team, our machine learning pipeline is currently stalled. GPU jobs are either failing immediately or remaining stuck in the Pending state indefinitely. We also noticed that one of our compute nodes is reporting fewer allocatable GPUs than usual, and users are complaining about broken training runs since this morning. Please investigate.

Hello Support Team, we are seeing many pods on node-prod-04 suddenly show as Evicted this morning. Our application dashboards are red and clients are complaining about intermittent errors. When we checked the node status, it shows DiskPressure. Can someone please look into this urgently? Thanks, Sarah.

URGENT: prod-api-west is throwing continuous errors across all client connections right now. The logs are flooded with x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid. Traffic is dropping and downstream services are timing out. Someone please look into this immediately.
prod-cluster-01 pods crashing in loop. liveness probe failing every few mins on startup and load. fix asap.
prod-worker-09 is NotReady. Pods showing Unknown/Terminating and rescheduling is crawling. Investigating node metrics now.

Hi Support Team, we are seeing intermittent image pull failures across many of our cluster nodes today. Our deployments are failing randomly with 429 Too Many Requests errors, and it is impacting our release pipeline. Could someone please look into this urgently? Thanks, Sarah from Acme Corp.

CRITICAL: endpoint /api/v1/status returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable with connection refused. Node status nominal, pod replicas: 4/4 Running, 4/4 Ready. Load balancer health checks failing across all availability zones.

prod deploy is busted. new pods stuck in CreateContainerConfigError across services after restart. old pods are still serving traffic so no total outage yet, but we are dead in the water for releases. fix asap.

Hello Support team, we noticed node production-worker-04 suddenly went NotReady this morning. All running pods are stuck in Unknown and Terminating states, and the rescheduling process is taking way longer than usual. Could someone please take a look at this ASAP?

Hello Support Team. We are running a multi-node training job under project Orion, and it keeps hanging midway before eventually failing with an NCCL watchdog timeout error. This is blocking our upcoming deadline, so could someone please investigate this issue as soon as possible?
ALERT: prod-us-east auth-service returning HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout. Pods show Running and Ready, but logs are flooded with upstream request timeouts. Impacting user logins.
ERROR: NCCL watchdog timeout detected on rank 0 during collective communication. Job terminated after hang.
CRITICAL: Service health check failed on gateway-04. Log output: [ERROR] TLS handshake failed for client 10.0.4.12: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid.
prod-us-west pods are in a severe CrashLoopBackOff state right after the recent config rollout. Nothing is starting up successfully. Need immediate eyes on this to mitigate downtime.
Prod training cluster 4 just hung on job #8842 and crashed with an NCCL watchdog timeout. Second time this happened today. Pls look ASAP.

Hello Support team, customers on our Acme Portal are reporting sudden gateway timeouts when trying to load their dashboards. Our monitoring shows the main API service is throwing 504 errors and logging upstream timeout messages, but when we check Kubernetes, all the backend pods are running and marked as completely healthy. Can someone please investigate this urgently?

Hi Support Team, our production environment for Project Phoenix is currently unusable. Pods keep getting killed and restarted every few minutes either during startup or when traffic spikes. Our users are reporting constant timeouts and disconnects. Please investigate this urgent issue immediately as it is impacting our revenue.

Prod alert: latency spike detected on gateway. Health probes failing intermittently across US-East. Application logs are completely clean and node CPU metrics are flat at 15 percent. Need immediate eyes on this.
prod-api pods in cluster-eu-west are dying repeatedly. Exit code 137 on every restart. Checking Grafana, memory usage flatlines at the limit right before the drop. Please investigate ASAP.

CRITICAL: Name resolution failing cluster-wide. 2023-10-27T14:02:11Z ERROR dns_resolver: lookup failed for service.internal: lookup cluster: i/o timeout. 2023-10-27T14:02:13Z WARN transport: no such host encountered during name resolution.

NAMESPACE     NAME                       STATUS    REPORTS
production    ai-inference-worker-7b5f   Pending   0/12 nodes are available: Insufficient cpu, 3 Insufficient memory, 8 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.

Hello Support Team. We are currently trying to upgrade our production Kubernetes cluster, but the process has completely frozen. Several nodes are stuck in a drain state and workload eviction is constantly being refused. Please assist us as soon as possible because our maintenance window is closing.
CRITICAL: Node gpu-worker-09 reporting 0 allocatable GPUs. System logs: dmesg: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 31, pid=0, Descriptors exhausted. Job queue backing up across the cluster.

NAME READY STATUS RESTARTS AGE
app-server-76d9f 0/1 ImagePullBackOff 0 2m
app-server-76d9f 0/1 ErrImagePull 0 3m
prod alert: deployment checkout-service new rs 0 pods created. events logging FailedCreate exceeded quota. please investigate ASAP.

URGENT: Deploy of service-alpha just went out and all new pods are completely dead in the water. Status is throwing continuous ErrImagePull and ImagePullBackOff errors right out of the gate. Nothing is starting up. Need someone to look at this now before customer impact escalates.

Hi Support Team, since our deployment earlier this morning, whenever we roll out a new version or restart a service, the new pods get completely stuck in a CreateContainerConfigError state. Fortunately, our old pods are still up and serving traffic, but we cannot promote any new changes right now. Please investigate urgently. Thanks, Sarah from Acme Corp.

prod cluster upgrade is totally stuck on node ip-10-0-44-12. drain command has been hanging for twenty minutes and pod eviction keeps getting refused across multiple namespaces. need eyes on this asap before our pipeline breaks.

Hi Support Team, our application users are experiencing intermittent 503 errors and connection refused messages when trying to reach the billing-api in production. Interestingly, kubectl shows all pods are in a Running and Ready state. Can someone please look into this urgently as it is impacting checkout?

Hi Support Team, our checkout service deployment in cluster us-east-1 is completely stuck. The new pods show as running in kubectl, but they never pass readiness checks, so the rollout has halted and traffic is dropping. Can someone please look into this?

Hello Support Team, ever since our security update this morning, the billing service cannot talk to the user database. Calls keep timing out completely. DNS is resolving the hostnames properly, but requests are failing. Can someone please look into this urgently as customers are impacted?

node-04 dropped from 8 to 6 allocatable GPUs. Slurm queue is blocked with pending jobs and active ones are crashing. Kernel logs are spamming NVIDIA Xid errors. Need urgent help to fix this cluster node before deadlines.
prod-cluster: pods in ns-payments stuck in ContainerCreating, throwing FailedAttachVolume and Multi-Attach errors across multiple nodes. Need eyes on this ASAP.

cluster-prod-02 experiencing widespread random pod startup failures. kubectl describe shows repeated 429 Too Many Requests errors during container image pulls across multiple worker nodes. Investigating now but need immediate eyes on this from platform engineering.
CRITICAL: Service connectivity failure between payment-api and fraud-detection. Error: Connection timed out after 30000ms. DNS resolution verified working. Happened immediately after policy change.
WARNING: Pod 'auth-service-789' terminated (exit code 137). Liveness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 500. Restart count: 12.

Hello Support Team, ever since we applied the latest environment variable update this morning, our user-auth pods in production have been continuously restarting. The dashboard shows them stuck in a repeating failure loop, and our users cannot log into the platform. Please investigate immediately.
Warning FailedAttachVolume 4m (x12 over 16m) attachdetach-controller Attach volume "vol-01928374" to instance "i-0987654321" failed: volume is already exclusively attached
NODE_NAME: worker-az2-01 | STATUS: NotReady | CONDITIONS: DiskPressure=True | AFFECTED_PODS: 14 evicted
DEPLOYMENT_STALLED: deployment/payment-processor desired=5 current=5 updated=5 available=0 ready=0 endpoints=2
CRITICAL: Probe timeout rate > 25 percent on cluster-prod-7. P99 latency degraded from 120ms to 4500ms. Error logs: 0 events/sec. Node utilization: CPU 12%, Mem 41%.

Hello Support, AcmeCorp is experiencing severe issues today. Since this morning, our applications across the entire cluster are throwing intermittent 'no such host' and 'i/o timeout' errors when trying to resolve internal service names. This is severely impacting our user traffic. Please investigate immediately as we cannot reach our backend nodes reliably.

Hello Support Team. Since around 10 AM, our users at Acme Corp are completely unable to connect to the main API. Every single client request is instantly failing with x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid. This is blocking our daily operations completely. Please investigate and fix this urgently as soon as possible.

CRITICAL: Service checkout-api reporting 504 Gateway Timeouts. Logs show repeated upstream timeout errors, yet kubectl get pods indicates all replicas are running with zero restarts or health check failures. Immediate triage required.

Prod alert: auth-service to api-gateway requests timing out consistently since the security patch applied at 14:00 UTC. DNS lookups succeed with zero packet loss, but TCP connections drop on port 443. Investigating now.

WARN: Container image pull failed for pod app-frontend-7b89f-xyz due to registry rate limit error. HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests observed intermittently across 14 active nodes in region us-east-1.

Hello Support, since our last deployment this morning, none of our new pods in the analytics namespace are starting up. They are all stuck in a pending state and the status message keeps mentioning some kind of resource exhaustion for cpu and memory. Please investigate ASAP.
Warning: FailedCreate 3m ago (x14 over 12m) replica-set-controller Deployment/user-auth failed to create pod: pods "user-auth-7bf89d5f7f-" exceeded quota

Hello Support, AcmeCorp is experiencing severe slowdowns today. Our users are facing constant timeout errors when loading the dashboard, yet our internal status page shows everything is operational. Could you please investigate what is happening on your end?
prod-cluster: api-gateway throwing connection refused and 503 errors for users hitting auth-service. checked k8s and pods are 3/3 running and ready. traffic is not routing properly. investigate ASAP.
prod-cluster-east: pods stuck in Pending. Events show FailedScheduling: Insufficient cpu / memory / nvidia.com/gpu. Scaling is completely blocked for team-alpha. Needs immediate eyes.

hey team, prod is acting up again. seeing sporadic 'no such host' and 'i/o timeout' messages cluster-wide when trying to resolve service names. some requests work, others fail. looks pretty unstable right now. pinging here before it escalates further.
NODE_NOT_READY: worker-node-b2. Pod status: Unknown/Terminating. Reschedule latency exceeding SLA thresholds.
prod-cluster: node-08 is spamming DiskPressure. Dozens of pods just got evicted all at once. Traffic is spilling over and latency is spiking. Need eyes on this immediately.

Hello Support Team, we just pushed the latest release for project Phoenix to our staging cluster around ten minutes ago. However, none of the new pods are starting up successfully. Every single one of them is stuck in an ErrImagePull and ImagePullBackOff state immediately following the deployment. Please assist us in investigating this urgent issue as soon as possible.
WARNING: Node drain operation timed out on worker-pool-b; eviction refused for 14 pods; cluster upgrade stuck in progressing state.

Hi Support Team, our production environment for ACME Corp is completely down since this morning. Several pods are perpetually stuck in the ContainerCreating status. The logs keep complaining about FailedMount and FailedAttachVolume errors. Can someone look into this urgently please?

ALERT: PodDeploymentStalled - Namespace: production. Symptom: New pods stuck in CreateContainerConfigError status following restart/deploy event. Note: Previous generation pods are currently continuing to serve traffic successfully.

Hi Support Team, our production service for AcmeCorp keeps crashing every few minutes. Users are reporting that the dashboard is completely inaccessible. We noticed the containers are restarting with exit code 137, and the memory graphs spike right to the limit immediately before going down. Can you please check what is happening?

Hello Support Team, we just applied the latest configuration update in production. The system initially appeared healthy, but since then, every single attempt to use the export feature results in a 500 Internal Server Error for our users. Please investigate urgently as this is blocking our workflow.
prod alert: api config deployment successful yet feature x throwing 5xx errors on 100 percent of recent requests. check logs immediately.

CRITICAL: Service deployment completed at 14:02 UTC. Health checks report OK, but endpoint /v2/analytics returns HTTP 500 on all incoming traffic. Error log snippet: [ERROR] Failed to execute feature handler: NullReferenceException at ServiceWorker.Process.
